title: Indexing & Readiness | ContextMint Docs
description: How ContextMint indexes workspaces, progressive RAG during indexing, readiness phases, and priority file handling.
lead: Indexing builds vector and keyword indexes for hybrid search. Chat uses progressive retrieval — you can ask questions before indexing finishes.

rows.meaning: Health probe in flight or server bootstrapping
Index or session failure — check Engine → Indexing
Background walk in progress; partial index available
Search may work; Ollama offline — generation degraded
Index complete; watcher handles file deltas

produces.title: What indexing produces
items: Dependency graph — optional neighbour expansion in search
File hash cache — skip unchanged files on reindex

priority.title: Priority files
priority.intro: These paths are indexed and boosted first:
items: Open editor tabs (sent on workspace register)
Active file on editor change / save (prioritize-file)
Chat attachments and client grep hits (hot-paths)

progressive.title: Progressive RAG during indexing
progressive.intro: When you send chat while status is Indexing:
items: Active editor file is read from disk immediately
Hybrid search runs over whatever chunks exist so far
Server-side grep fallback if index results are empty
Extension client grep may run before stream (Repo / Hybrid lanes)

triggers.title: Reindex triggers
items: Warm restart catch-up for missing files after server restart
File watcher events for saves and renames

polling.title: Desktop vs extension polling
polling.text: Engine Indexing tab polls on a slower interval than the extension status bar. The extension may show Indexing while Engine overview still looks idle — use Indexing drill-down for truth.

inline.title: Inline completion while indexing
inline.p1: Ghost-text (inline) is off by default. When enabled, pause policy is server inline.pause_mode:
items: off — never pause for embed/reindex (shipped default)
shared_runtime — pause only when chat and embed share one Ollama host
on_embed_busy — pause whenever any session embed/reindex is busy
inline.p2Mid: to on_embed_busy; it cannot weaken a stricter server mode. Prefer shared_runtime on contested team servers — see
